paper_id: Wang et al. - 2019 - Spatio-Temporal Analysis and Prediction of Cellular Traffic in Metropolis
title: Spatio-Temporal Analysis and Prediction of Cellular Traffic in Metropolis
motivation: 5G时代运营商需要精准预测流量以优化资源配置,城市管理部门需要检测异常集会事件
problem_framing: 将蜂窝流量分解为in-tower和inter-tower两类,利用图神经网络建模城市级大规模cell tower的时空依赖关系
key_insight: 远距离cell tower之间存在强烈的空间依赖(城市交通使人员可在半小时内穿越全市),现有方法忽视此问题
method_signature: 图神经网络分解in-tower/inter-tower流量预测城市级蜂窝流量
evaluation_criteria: MAE, MARE, MAPE指标,在1.5M用户5929个cell tower大规模数据集上验证
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: without traffic decomposition, the neural network has similar encoding capacity to LSTM - 流量分解缺失导致GNN-A性能与LSTM相当
evidence_for_taste: fail to capture the intensive long-distance spatial dependency
spatial dependencies may not necessarily be local
fast urban-scale mobility introduces enormous long-distance spatial dependency
even with an imbalanced training dataset, our method still outperforms others
thinking_moves: 从数据中发现被忽视的时空模式:远距离cell tower间存在强依赖
将总流量分解为可解释的in-tower和inter-tower两部分以显式建模空间依赖
用图结构而非网格结构表示cell tower拓扑,适应实际网络管理需求
通过PageRank centrality量化spatial dependency验证方法优势
对比实验展示分解必要性:无分解时GNN等同于LSTM
cites_own_work: 基于ICNP 2017 preliminary version的完整扩展
